title: Operations family G1: one-line sentences (add / subtract 10 and 100, missing numbers + − × ÷) and zero in the quotient

template.also: div_zero_in_quotient is drawn on the `division` template (js/modules/sheet/cells/long-division.js). The brief named `fact` (notation horiz) for add_sub_10s / add_sub_100s; measured, the fact cell kept its 38 mm VA-70 height and its own digit ladder at every size (S printed the L page, 3 x 4; cells more than half empty), so G1 draws them on `equation` with unknown 'result' (open question 1).

summary: Five same-shape skills moved off the legacy print path in one batch: four one-line number sentences on the kit `equation` cell (the unknown's own slot: a box before =, the answer line after =) and one long division on the kit `division` bracket (a box over every dividend digit). Paper, key and screen draw one cell.
teaches: add_sub_10s: 10 more / 10 less than any number to 100 (1.NBT.C.5, 1.NBT.C.6 partial). add_sub_100s: 100 more / 100 less than any number to 1,000 (2.NBT.B.8). missing_add_sub: the unknown in an addition or subtraction sentence, before the = sign (1.OA.D.8). missing_mult_div: the unknown factor, dividend or divisor in a × or ÷ sentence (3.OA.A.4). div_zero_in_quotient: write 0 in the quotient where the divisor does not go into a place (4.NBT.B.6, M-D2).
research: From repo sources (design/catalogue/addition.md rows 61, 62, 79, 118-119, 188; subtraction.md 136, 194; mult-div-integers.md 118, 213, 279, 315; PEDAGOGY_STANDARD; PROBLEM_TYPES). MathWorksheets4Kids / IXL logins were not used in this batch (pending).
problemTypes: 10 more / 10 less across: 43 + 10 = __, 67 − 10 = __ (any start number, not only multiples of 10)
missing addend: __ + 5 = 12, 7 + __ = 15; missing whole: __ − 4 = 9; missing part: 13 − __ = 6
missing factor: __ × 6 = 42, 8 × __ = 56; missing dividend / divisor: __ ÷ 4 = 8, 42 ÷ __ = 7 (Across, Bracket or Fraction bar)
long division with a 0 in the quotient: middle place (7)721 = 103), last place (3)930 = 310), four-digit dividend at Max Number 1,000+ (4)4092 = 1023)
progression: add_sub_10s: adding only, then subtracting only (task option), then mixed with the sign read per item
add_sub_10s numbers to 50, then to 100 (band option)
add_sub_100s: the same steps to 500, then 1,000
missing_add_sub: + only, then − only, then mixed; the answer position is opt-in (unknown option)
missing_mult_div: × facts first (Across), then ÷ in the notation the class uses
div_zero_in_quotient: 3-digit ÷ 1-digit, then 4-digit dividends at Max Number 1,000

drawing.sizes: digits 16 / 22 / 28 pt at S / M / L (tokens.js SIZES); the slot B(n) from the widest answer the page's band allows (L3). Equation rows stretch at most 2.0 x (PG-11). The division bracket: one box over every dividend digit, two work rows per dividend digit.
notes: equation payload: {a, b, op, result, unknown: 'a'|'b'|'result', digits, notation?}; digits = widest possible answer on the page, never the item's own answer.
division payload: {dividend, divisor, quotient, workRows: 2 x dividend digits} so neither boxes nor rows tell the quotient's digit count.
Screen: the twin's one slot carries data-mq-blank (box before =, line after =); the division twin's quotient boxes are typed one digit each.

ownerRulings.ruling: "Within N" bounds the ANSWER (the sum, the number you take from, the product, the number shared), never the operands.
A distinct option is ALSO a findable skill: 10 more / 10 less (and 100) and the answer-position step are listed as preset candidates for the lead, not built in G1.

misconceptions.error: changed the ones digit instead of the tens (43 + 10 = 44)
changed the tens digit instead of the hundreds (367 + 100 = 377)
added when the sign says take away
SU-M7: subtracts when the unknown is the minuend (__ − 4 = 9 → 5)
M-D2: skips the place the divisor does not go into (721 ÷ 7 = 13)
misconceptions.wrong: quotient with its inner / trailing 0 dropped

options: add_sub_10s / add_sub_100s: task (Adding / Subtracting; both = mixed, the instruction reads the sign), band (Numbers to 50 / 500, else 100 / 1,000).
missing_add_sub: unknown (default: a number before the = sign; the answer is opt-in), task (+ / −).
missing_mult_div: notation (Across default; Bracket / Fraction bar keep the equation's ÷ branch; several ticked mixes them by the teacher's choice).
div_zero_in_quotient: Max Number 1,000 adds four-digit dividends.
Preset candidates for the lead (not built): 10 more / 10 less, 100 more / 100 less (task presets), missing number with the answer position (unknown preset).

openQuestions.q: add_sub_10s / add_sub_100s on `fact` (horiz) as briefed, or on `equation`?
openQuestions.recommended: `equation` (unknown 'result'): measured, `fact` across printed 3 x 4 = 12 items at both S and L with the answer line under the sentence and > 50 % of every cell empty; `equation` reads S / M / L (L 2 x 5, S 3 x 7 for 10s).

openQuestions.q: missing_mult_div: drop the plain product / quotient (after =) from the default?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes, done in G1: the skill is 'Missing Factors'; the plain fact is mult_facts / div_facts. An `unknown` option like missing_add_sub's can bring it back if the owner wants it.

openQuestions.q: Split add_sub_10s / add_sub_100s into add / sub skills (catalogue)?
openQuestions.recommended: Keep the ids (share codes); the task option gives one operation per page, and presets make each findable.
